output.summary: The commit adds a rounding test for formatPrice and changes build and test configuration: the CI Node version, the package version and test script, and a stricter TypeScript option. The pieces have no code edges between them, so they read as independent edits.

groups.title: New formatPrice rounding test
groups.description: Adds a 'rounds half up' case expecting formatPrice(0.125) to give '0.13'. Check that the expectation matches formatPrice's intended rounding, since floating-point representation can affect half-way values.

groups.title: Test script, version and CI Node bump
groups.description: The test script now runs vitest with --coverage, the package version goes to 1.0.1, and CI moves from Node 20 to 22. Check that the coverage provider is installed, because only vitest is listed in devDependencies, and that Node 22 is intended.

groups.title: Stricter TypeScript indexing checks
groups.description: Enables noUncheckedIndexedAccess. This looks unrelated to the other edits. Check that the existing code still type-checks under it.
